`caique/inquirer/prompts` — `@inquirer/prompts`' prompts, over `caique/inquirer`'s loop.

```ts
import { Separator, checkbox, select } from 'caique/inquirer/prompts';
```

## Constants

### checkbox

Ask for any of `choices`.

```ts
const checkbox: <Value>(config: CheckboxConfig<Value>, context?: import("./inquirer.js").Context) => import("./inquirer.js").CancelablePromise<Value[]>;
```

### select

Ask for one of `choices`.

```ts
const select: <Value>(config: SelectConfig<Value>, context?: import("./inquirer.js").Context) => import("./inquirer.js").CancelablePromise<Value>;
```

## Interfaces

### CheckboxConfig

`checkbox`'s configuration, as `@inquirer/checkbox` declares it.

```ts
interface CheckboxConfig<Value> {
    message: string;
    prefix?: string;
    pageSize?: number;
    choices: readonly (Value | Choice<Value> | Separator)[];
    loop?: boolean;
    required?: boolean;
    validate?: (choices: readonly NormalizedChoice<Value>[]) => boolean | string | Promise<string | boolean>;
    theme?: PartialTheme<CheckboxTheme>;
    shortcuts?: {
        all?: string | null;
        invert?: string | null;
    };
}
```

### CheckboxTheme

What `checkbox` adds to the core theme.

```ts
interface CheckboxTheme {
    icon: {
        checked: string;
        unchecked: string;
        cursor: string;
        disabledChecked: string;
        disabledUnchecked: string;
    };
    style: {
        disabled: (text: string) => string;
        renderSelectedChoices: <T>(selectedChoices: readonly NormalizedChoice<T>[], allChoices: readonly Item<T>[]) => string;
        description: (text: string) => string;
        keysHelpTip: (keys: [key: string, action: string][]) => string | undefined;
    };
    i18n: {
        disabledError: string;
    };
}
```

### Choice

A choice as a caller may write it.

```ts
interface Choice<Value> {
    value: Value;
    name?: string;
    checkedName?: string;
    description?: string;
    short?: string;
    disabled?: boolean | string;
    checked?: boolean;
    type?: never;
}
```

### NormalizedChoice

A choice once the prompt has filled in every field.

```ts
interface NormalizedChoice<Value> {
    value: Value;
    name: string;
    checkedName: string;
    description?: string;
    short: string;
    disabled: boolean | string;
    checked: boolean;
}
```

### SelectConfig

`select`'s configuration, as `@inquirer/select` declares it.

```ts
interface SelectConfig<Value> {
    message: string;
    choices: readonly (Value | Omit<Choice<Value>, 'checked' | 'checkedName'> | Separator)[];
    pageSize?: number;
    loop?: boolean;
    default?: NoInfer<Value>;
    theme?: PartialTheme<SelectTheme>;
}
```

### SelectTheme

What `select` adds to the core theme.

```ts
interface SelectTheme {
    icon: {
        cursor: string;
    };
    style: {
        disabled: (text: string) => string;
        description: (text: string) => string;
        keysHelpTip: (keys: [key: string, action: string][]) => string | undefined;
    };
    i18n: {
        disabledError: string;
    };
    indexMode: 'hidden' | 'number';
}
```
